scope: Additive index, not replacement for original safety records; most restrictive applicable rule wins.

dependent_outcome_holds.rule: Block affected estimates dependent on retracted trials pending outcome-specific reanalysis; not a formal retraction claim.

Block pregnancy and live birth pooled effects and downstream use; includes DR023. Do not automatically invalidate unrelated semen outcomes.

claim_constraints.finding: Common MTHFR variants do not establish need to replace folic acid with 5-MTHF; CDC recommends folic acid, which has direct NTD prevention evidence. DHFR substitution claim unverified. CDC clinician guidance starts at least one month before conception; three months can be planning preference not universal minimum.

Acute fetal hemodynamic outcomes and self-selected lifting survey cannot establish universal heavy-lifting, Valsalva or supine exercise safety. No home fetal heart-rate thresholds or blanket clearance.
Acitretin pregnancy avoidance period is at least 3 years; nursing warning separate. Do not promise safe conception solely from an elapsed isotretinoin washout.
No personalized genotype/race-based DHA dose or testing recommendation. Bayesian posterior probabilities are not individual benefit probabilities; credible intervals differ from confidence intervals.
Gemini conflates anxiety and depression effect sizes. Depression SMD -.52; anxiety -.25; maintain separate outcomes.
LactMed reports lack of breastfeeding hydroquinone studies, not proven harm; distinguish precaution/unknown from established contraindication. Retain pregnancy avoidance and existing retinoid holds.
Vitamin D 2024 review addresses uncertainty of supplementation for obstetric outcomes; 2026 dose comparison is distinct. Do not infer dietary requirement or deficiency treatment is unnecessary.
Pneumatic compression vs rest is not a stocking-prevention trial; existing S127 evaluates stockings. Distinguish symptom relief, structural prevention and VTE care.

additional_constraints.rule: Commercial formula claim evidence must not be used to infer nutritional equivalence to human milk or superiority without direct credible evidence; regulated age-appropriate formula remains a safe and necessary feeding option when needed. No homemade, diluted or unregulated substitutes.

No causal claim that disposable diapers delay independent continence or that cloth or assisted infant toileting prevents disorders without appropriate evidence; distinguish cue recognition, assisted dryness and independent toileting. No forced or punitive training.

runtime_enforcement: not implemented; Claude must implement and test before any release
